summary: MPU-6050 6-axis accelerometer and gyroscope (mpu6050): 13 pins, interfaces i2c; source class A1.

pins.name: AUX_DA
pins.note: auxiliary I²C master data to external sensors, not the host bus

pins.name: AUX_CL
pins.note: auxiliary I²C master clock to external sensors, not the host bus

pins.name: REGOUT
pins.note: regulator filter capacitor 0.1 µF to GND (p. 22), no signal

pins.name: CPOUT
pins.note: charge pump capacitor 2.2 nF (p. 22), no signal

f_max_hz.evidence: I2C Operating Frequency All registers, Fast-mode   400 kHz

interfaces.note: I²C only (the SPI variant is the MPU-6000); bus level set by VLOGIC (p. 25)

min.conditions: max is VDD (VLOGIC must be ≤ VDD at all times)

evidence: VIH, High Level Input Voltage MPU-6000 0.7*VDD
vih.conditions: digital inputs SDA, SCL, AD0, FSYNC, CLKIN

evidence: VIL, Low Level Input Voltage MPU-6000
vil.conditions: digital inputs SDA, SCL, AD0, FSYNC, CLKIN

vol.conditions: SDO, INT; RLOAD = 1 MΩ (SDA: 0.4 V at 3 mA sink, p. 16)

evidence: Input Voltage Level (CLKIN, AUX_DA,  AD0, FSYNC, INT,

typ.evidence: Normal Operating Current Gyroscope + Accelerometer + DMP  3.9  mA

requires.evidence: VDD Bypass Capacitor (Pin 13) C2 Ceramic, X7R, 0.1
VLOGIC Bypass Capacitor (Pin 8) C4* Ceramic, X7R, 10nF
Regulator Filter Capacitor (Pin 10) C1 Ceramic, X7R, 0.1

requires.note: charge pump capacitor C3 (rated 50 V; CPOUT reaches up to 30 V, p. 20)
requires.evidence: Charge Pump Capacitor (Pin 20) C3 Ceramic, X7R, 2.2nF

requires.note: the text says VDD; for the MPU-6050 the bus level is VLOGIC (p. 25). Value from the I²C pull-up calculator
requires.evidence: SDA and SCL lines typically need pull -up resistors to VDD.

notes.text: VLOGIC must stay at or below VDD at all times; its absolute maximum is VDD + 0.5 V.
notes.evidence: VLOGIC Input Voltage Level (MPU-6050) -0.5V to VDD + 0.5V

notes.text: Two MPU-6050 can share one bus: AD0 low = 0x68, AD0 high = 0x69. 0x68 is also the address of common RTCs (DS1307/DS3231).
notes.evidence: determined by the logic level on pin AD0. This allows two MPU-60X0s to be connected to the same I 2C bus.

notes.text: GY-521 breakouts add a 3.3 V regulator, I²C pull-ups and a pull-down on AD0 (address 0x68); TDK documents the bare chip only.
